method_detail: 2D RNN wavefunction; zero-variance energy per L, then linear regression of E(L) = E_inf + e1/L^3 over all L with a wild bootstrap (10^3 bootstraps)
method_as_published: 'Our extrapolated value for the ground-state energy is E_inf = -0.6694886(5)'
reference: Moss, Wiersema, Hibat-Allah, Carrasquilla & Melko, Leveraging recurrence in neural network wavefunctions for large-scale simulations of Heisenberg antiferromagnets on the square lattice, Phys. Rev. B 112, 134450 (2025), arXiv:2502.17144
evidence: Section on zero-variance energies, lines 394-401 of sources/2502.17144.txt (Eq. (7), periodic boundary conditions); the journal citation is the one of the existing rows of this paper in data/; the journal text was not re-read for this value; version read: arXiv text
convention_check: Square-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet, energy per spin in the S.S convention (compared with the QMC reference -0.669437(5), same line); periodic boundaries (Eq. (7) is for periodic boundary conditions); every L used. No conversion; stored per site x 4 by the loader. The value is a zero-variance, finite-size extrapolation, not an upper bound. 2601.20189 quotes this number from this paper; the row is cited to Moss et al. (RULES.md 8).

method_detail: DMRG and FAMPS (fully augmented MPS) on L x 2L cylinders, L = 8 to 16, periodic in y and open in x; each size extrapolated to zero truncation error, then linear in 1/L
method_as_published: DMRG/FAMPS; 'linear extrapolation of the energy with 1/L'
reference: Qian, Lv, Lee & Qin, From the Shastry-Sutherland model to the J1-J2 Heisenberg model, arXiv:2411.17452 (version dated 27 Nov 2024)
evidence: Appendix A.1 (line 412-416) and Fig. S1 caption (lines 421-424) of sources/2411.17452.txt: '-0.44844(8)'; cylinders L x 2L (lines 103-104), periodic in y, open in x (lines 125-126); version read: arXiv text dated 27 Nov 2024; no journal version looked up (arXiv-only, RULES.md 8)
convention_check: Eq. (3), lines 100-110: H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i.S_j + J3 sum_<<ij>> in blue S_i.S_j + J3' sum in red S_i.S_j; J3' = 0 is the Shastry-Sutherland model (J1 on the square bonds, J3 on the blue orthogonal dimers); alpha := J1/J3 = 0.80 (line 412); energies per site in the S.S convention, J3 = 1. Check: the 6x6 periodic exact value printed at alpha = 0.80, -0.4517531 (line 420), equals the exact energy per site of ShastrySutherland/square_36_P_J0.8_Jd1 in data/ (-0.4517531), so J = 0.8, Jd = 1 and the unit is the same. Spin-1/2 (S operators). Stored per site x 4 (S.S to Pauli) by the loader. No error bar on the 6x6 value is needed. New instance: the loader's tdlId has no ShastrySutherland entry (id by RULES 2.1: J then Jd).

reference: Gong, Sheng, Motrunich & Fisher, Phase diagram of spin-1/2 J1-J2 Heisenberg model on honeycomb lattice, arXiv:1306.6067
evidence: Introduction, lines 126-129 and Fig. 3 caption (lines 176-) of sources/1306.6067.txt; version read: arXiv text, journal version not looked up (arXiv-only, RULES.md 8)
